key_terms.ثِقَةٌ: Reliable/Trustworthy, a technical term in hadith sciences indicating a narrator's integrity and precision
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رِبَاطٍ: Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Ribat, the narrator being identified

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Ribat and what is his status as a narrator?
ai.summary: This entry from Kitab al-Du'afa (or a biographical dictionary) identifies the narrator Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Ribat. The repetition of 'thiqa' emphasizes his reliability and trustworthiness in transmitting hadith.
